answer: Score each identity's on-chain history like a geologist reads shale: require a minimum wallet age and enough counterparties before full power. Sybil farms mint thousands of wallets from one funding source at once, leaving star-shaped clusters in the graph -- the way a weed monoculture betrays itself in a garden. Attacker cost becomes months of aging plus gas per identity, and an early aged record behaves like an opal: valuable because faking it at scale takes too long. Limitation: aged wallets can be bought and mixers blur the graph, so this raises forgery cost rather than proving honesty.
